skill.summary: Briefing matutino diario calibrado para Argentina y LATAM. Actívate cuando el usuario pida el briefing del día, resumen de la mañana, qué hay hoy, agenda del...

latestVersion.changelog: Initial public release. Morning briefing skill calibrated for Argentina and LATAM. Operates in ART (UTC-3) with DD/MM/AAAA dates, Spanish day names, ISO week numbers, and 2026 Argentine holidays including official tourism non-working days (Decreto 614/2025 + Res 164/2025). Auto-integrates with argentina-fiscal-calendar if installed. No external APIs required.
